ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio; approximately 40% high-intensity white pixels localized at lateral lobes vs 60% low-intensity black pixels dominant in the central and trailing regions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Bilateral high-intensity white contiguous zones on the distal thirds of both lobes. Central third is a contiguous low-intensity black region containing discrete white circular focal spots and mottle. Medial transition zones show high-frequency black/white mottle.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression; estimated interior pixel angle of 85 degrees; vertical notch depth is approximately 18% of the total vertical fluke height visible.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Extreme serration; left lobe trailing edge displays high-amplitude jagged peaks (5-8 major peaks); right lobe trailing edge displays moderate-amplitude, high-frequency serrations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex sweep from the median notch extending to acutely upturned, jagged lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense spatial clusters of circular white rings (diameter 5-15 pixels) on the black right lobe; prominent clusters of high-intensity calcified structures (barnacles) localized at the extreme lateral tips.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Set of 3-4 parallel high-contrast linear streaks (rake marks) oriented diagonally on the upper black region of the right lobe; horizontal white linear mark in the lower-central black region.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular tissue erosion and asymmetric indentations along the trailing edge of the left lobe, indicating previous trauma or parasitic wear.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly unique 'constellation' pattern of circular white scars on the black surface of the right fluke lobe.
